title: Elements, compounds and mixtures as particles
caption: Helium is an element made of single atoms; oxygen is an element made of O₂ molecules; water is a compound, every molecule the same H₂O; air is a mixture of different substances.
alt: Four boxes of particles: separate helium atoms; O₂ molecules; H₂O molecules; and a mixture of N₂ and O₂ molecules with an argon atom.
description: Helium: single atoms, one kind only, so an element.
Oxygen: pairs of identical atoms (O₂), an element.
Water: every molecule one O and two H, a compound.
Air: N₂, O₂ and argon mixed, a mixture.
